jobs.occupation: Electrical Engineer, Electrician (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:

You will start your working day directly from home, and your working time begins as soon as you travel to your first customer.

Job description

In order to support our team “Supp. Engineering Trsp./Miss. GE”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).

The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. This is achieved by integrating diagnostic functions, sensors and standardized interfaces to ensure that fault identification, isolation and verification are performed with maximum speed, precision and cost-efficiency. The overall target is minimizing MTTR and diagnostic costs.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

In order to support our Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

System Engineer (d/f/m) in Self Protection System

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours (30) and an adapted scope of tasks.

The need for military helicopters is increasing in the current geopolitical context. Military customers are demanding more and more performance from the active self-protection system. On the other hand, technologies are evolving fast with the introduction of the artificial intelligence. Mastering the Electronic Warfare System is key for the military business.
In this context, your mission will be to manage the development and the integration of new and complex Electronic Warfare Systems (EWS) into militarized helicopters to ensure the protection of the aircraft and the crew.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

jobs.occupation: PhD Explainable VLMs for Anomaly Detection in Crashworthiness Analyses (f/m/x) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 195225

Our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad have made us one of the world's leading premium manufacturer of cars and motorcycles as well as provider of premium financial and mobility services.

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE CREATE WHEN WE TAKE OUR VISIONS TO THE LIMITS.

PHD AT THE BMW GROUP.

Bridging the gap between your doctoral studies and the kind of career challenge you’re looking for isn’t always easy. That’s why our ProMotion PhD programme gives you the opportunity to apply your passion and scientific expertise to very real challenges that could shape the future of mobility. If selected, you’ll have the chance to really develop your own future career path with us through your practice-related thesis, promote your chosen specialty from within – and position yourself to secure the career you’ve always wanted.

As a PhD student in our team at the BMW Group, you contribute to AI-based crash video evaluation using vision-language models. You support the development of innovative AI models and data-driven methods that help improve the accuracy and efficiency of crashworthiness assessments in automotive safety engineering.

What awaits you?

- You support the development of AI models for vehicle crash behavior using modern geometric AI architectures.
- Together with the team, you help integrate machine learning and data analytics approaches with physics-based simulations to improve prediction accuracy.
- You also contribute to the development of automated workflows and optimization methods for crash simulations.
- Within the project, you support research on AI models for CAx (CAD, CAE, etc.) applications in the crash design process for cars.

What should you bring along?

- Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
- Extensive knowledge of computer vision and multimodal / vision-language models, e.g. transformers or CLIP-type architectures.
- Experience with data preprocessing, annotation workflows, and large multimodal datasets, including images, videos, and point clouds.
- A track record of research contributions, such as publications or conference talks, is a plus.
- Business-fluent English; German language skills are a plus.

Are you motivated and keen to help us shape the mobility of tomorrow? Apply now!

Find out more about Artificial Intelligence at the BMW Grouphere  .

If you make it to the next round, you will receive an invitation to a video interview by e-mail. Please also check your spam folder regularly.

What do we offer?

- Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding.
- Personal & professional development.
- Flexible working hours.
- Digital offers & mobile working.
- Attractive & fair remuneration.
- Annual special payments such as vacation pay and Christmas bonus.
- Apartment offers for students (subject to availability & only Munich).
- And many other benefits – seebmw.jobs/benefits

Start date: From now on

In September 2025, AUMOVIO emerged as a spin-off from Continental’s former Automotive group sector and has since established itself as an independent technology company. In fiscal year 2025, AUMOVIO generated sales of € 18.5 billion. Headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, AUMOVIO has around 82,000 employees at more than 80 locations worldwide.

We are seeking an executive leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit design to lead a strategically important global organization. In this role, you will drive innovation, technology leadership, and organizational excellence while shaping next-generation semiconductor solutions for demanding automotive applications.

As Head of Analog Design (m/f/d), you will lead a global organization of highly skilled engineers across multiple locations worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and executing the organization's analog design strategy, ensuring world-class designs, engineering excellence and enabling sustainable business growth through innovative semiconductor solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

- Defining and executing the long-term Analog Design strategy aligned with business objectives
- Leading, mentoring, and developing leaders, and engineering teams across global sites
- Overseeing the complete analog IC development lifecycle from concept through production readiness
- Driving technology innovation, development excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives
- Establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships with design houses, universities, foundries, OSATs, and ecosystem partners
- Managing budgets, resource allocation, capability development, and organizational growth
- Influencing product portfolio decisions, technology roadmaps, and business case development
- Representing the company in industry forums, conferences, and strategic technology networks

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Physics, or comparable qualification
- Long term experience in semiconductor and IC development
- Experience managing substantial budgets, resources, and organizational growth
- Proven track record of bringing complex semiconductor products to mass production and building high-performing engineering organizations
- Significant leadership experience within international R&D organizations
- Demonstrated success leading diverse, geographically distributed teams
- Recognized technology and people leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog design and semiconductor technologies
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)
- Strong strategic thinking and business acumen
- Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive leadership capabilities

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.
